_comment: Move-order ghost preview per-formation geometry: hold Space so the orders overlay is live, select the Spearmen (seed 12345, ~452,300), form Square (O), then right-click to march them. Before the fix, the ghost preview always drew the wide 2:1 line grid (UnitFormation.slots) even for a squared unit; after the fix it reads formation_slots(), so the ghost matches the real square footprint the unit is actually standing in -- compare the live block's shape to the ghost dots at the destination.

overlap.reason: Forming Square then marching packs the block inside the overlap floor for a judged sample of the reform (nnd_min 1.58 wu). The clip's subject is the move-order ghost matching the square footprint, not intra-block spacing during the reform; expected under the current square assignment.
